note: Pricing is a starting-at guide for our service area. Every quote is flat-rate and includes delivery, setup, a technician where listed, and teardown. HST extra.

groups.title: Wedding Packages
groups.description: Three ways to light a wedding, from golden and intimate to full production. Every package includes DMX scene control, setup before guests arrive and a quiet strike at the end of the night.

packages.name: The Romantic Glow
packages.tagline: Golden warmth that makes everyone look their best in photos.
packages.idealFor: Barn weddings, vineyard receptions, tent and backyard weddings, intimate gatherings
includes: 12 wireless amber or warm-white uplights
100 ft Edison string light canopy or perimeter run
DMX dimming scenes for dinner and first dance
On-site technician for the evening
Delivery, setup and 30-minute strike
packages.alt: Garden wedding lit with warm string lights and uplighting, the look of the Romantic Glow package

packages.name: The Modern Gala
packages.idealFor: Ballroom receptions, hotel venues, modern loft and gallery spaces
includes: 16 wireless uplights in your wedding colours
10 pinspots on centrepieces and cake
Head table and stage wash lighting
Custom DMX scene programming, cocktails to dance floor
On-site technician all evening
Delivery, setup and strike
packages.alt: Clear tent reception with criss-crossed string lights, the look of the Modern Gala package

packages.name: The Epic Afterparty
packages.tagline: The moment your guests pull out their phones.
packages.idealFor: Grand entrances, first dances, late-night dance parties, New Year's Eve weddings
includes: Everything in The Modern Gala
Pair of indoor-safe cold spark fountains, fired on cue
4 intelligent moving-head lights over the dance floor
Light haze for visible beams
Live-operated DMX light show for the reception
Full production technician
packages.alt: Guests celebrating under string lights at a tented wedding, the look of the Epic Afterparty package

groups.title: Corporate Event Packages

packages.name: Brand Glow
packages.tagline: Your brand colours on every wall.
packages.idealFor: Client appreciation nights, product launches, holiday parties, open houses
includes: 16 wireless uplights matched to your brand colours
Entrance and bar accent lighting
Podium or presentation wash
Setup before doors, strike after close
Certificate of insurance for your venue
packages.alt: Corporate lobby lit for an event with a decorated tree and garland

packages.name: Gala Production
packages.tagline: Camera-ready from the red carpet to the awards.
packages.idealFor: Galas, fundraisers, awards nights, conferences with an evening reception
includes: 24 wireless uplights in brand or theme colours
Stage, podium and panel wash for photo and video
12 pinspots on centrepieces and awards
Moving-head accents and optional cold sparks for reveals
Live DMX operation by an on-site technician
Venue and AV coordination, insurance certificate
packages.alt: Walk-through tunnel of light arches in a commercial atrium, an example of gala production lighting

packages.name: Patio Social
packages.tagline: Summer socials and team events under Edison bulbs.
packages.idealFor: Staff appreciation, summer socials, outdoor client events, private parties

6 uplights on trees, fence line or tent poles
Pathway and entrance lighting
Setup the afternoon of, removal the next day
Weather-rated for rain
packages.alt: Long patio dinner table lit by bistro string lights at dusk, the look of the Patio Social package

25 ft of pre-lit garland on the bar, mantel or railing

Party-night install and next-day removal
